findings.title: StatefulSet's peers have no DNS records until they are ready
findings.cause: container member exits because it cannot resolve its peer quorum-1.quorum: headless Service quorum publishes a pod's DNS record only once the pod is ready, and the peers become ready only after they find each other, so they wait on each other for ever; its log says: "wget: bad address 'quorum-1.quorum:7000'"; StatefulSet quorum has 0 of 3 replicas ready

evidence.what: container member exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container member's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
wget: bad address 'quorum-1.quorum:7000'
cannot join the quorum without quorum-1

evidence.what: headless Service quorum, the StatefulSet's serviceName, publishes ready pods only
evidence.command: kubectl get service quorum -n kd-statefulset-peer-dns -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}{" "}{.spec.publishNotReadyAddresses}'

findings.fix: Set publishNotReadyAddresses: true on Service quorum, so each pod's name resolves as soon as it has an address (the usual setting for the Service of a database or consensus cluster's peers); keep a separate Service for clients that should reach ready pods only.
